info.title: Rotor
info.description: Rotor's HTTP API: workflows across Exciter, Armature and Stator. Every endpoint answers JSON; errors share one envelope. Sign in through the suite's identity provider; the session is a cookie.

post.description: Envelope v1 from Armature, Exciter and Stator, CloudEvents (v2) from Exciter. 202 once the event is kept for the triggers it starts; 200 for an event already received or a ping; 401 for a signature that is wrong or older than the replay window; 404 for a tool without a secret; 413 for a body too large; 422 for a version Rotor does not read.

post.summary: Start a run of a workflow as yourself.

parameters.description: Any text of at most 200 characters, new for each run; a retry sends the same.
